title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
keyIdea: In RPN each operator comes right after its two operands. Read left to right with a stack: push numbers; on an operator pop b (top), then a, push a op b. The single value left is the answer.

approaches.name: Recursion from the end
approaches.idea: The last token is the outermost operator. Recursively evaluate its right operand (the tokens just before it), then its left operand.
approaches.why: Each token is read once. The recursion can go n levels deep for a long chain, which uses the call stack instead of an explicit one.

approaches.name: Stack
approaches.idea: Number → push. Operator → b = pop, a = pop, push a op b. Return the top at the end.
approaches.why: One pass; every token is pushed or causes two pops and one push. The stack holds at most about n/2 + 1 numbers.

quiz.q: Tokens "4 2 -". Which is a and which is b?
Why is a stack the right structure?
options: An operator always uses the two most recent unused values (last in, first out)

quiz.q: For a valid expression, how many numbers are left on the stack at the end?
